author: strandedsnake
quote: This game is pure trash. It allows people to objectify women and men, and it defies players to actually play through the main story, which is, in my opinion, overhyped and overrated. This GTA 6 is just for grown ass man who need to larp and satisfy their instability and loneliness and mostly play "good boyfriend simulator". This whole mechanic with Lucia was completely optional right? Well, it isn't. Your partner will be spending time with her, buying her flowers, necklaces, while you're left on delivered, and say "it's just a game, chill out". Isn't that completely insane? Because I think it is. This game makes people larp and distract themselves from the actual thing, that could've maybe been interesting. With this said, I wanted to express my immense disagreement to the whole integrity of this game.

author: strandedsnake
quote:
Just perfect. Kojima added and fixed everything the first game didn't have even though it was perfect anyway. The story was so immersive, and the introduction of the new characters was just right on the spot and made me love the story even more. Last but not least, the actors were AMAZING. Specifically loved Luca Marinelli's performance (Italian pride) as Neil Vana, and his whole storyline was really good. Also loved both Léa Seydoux as Fragile and Troy Baker as Higgs.
Not to mention that it still keeps me glued to the screen and currently working on the platinum.
Lastly, the team did an OUTSTANDING job with the graphics.
